review_notes: I read the whole file. It defines two things: `restrictedDivisionRemainder` and `restrictedDivisionQuotient`. Both are thin named specialisations of the library's own `restrictedLinearExtension`. I found the extension, `adicReduction` and `polynomialToRestricted` in the project's IdealAdicRestricted files, and I did not open those definitions. The only other independent declaration is the private `restricted_eq_of_reductions`, which is an ext-style theorem. The rubric excludes standalone theorem duplication, so I did not count it. I found no competing Mathlib concept for restricted-series division. I did not run a broad search of Mathlib for a matching quotient or remainder on power series. The file's definitions are the named API for this purpose, so I do not report them as competing versions of an existing concept.
